name: Something Is Missing
author: Noodlebake
description:
Noodlebake's debut micro-game! Think of it more as an interactive music video. Super simple side scroller with one true objective: enjoy the music! Run, hop and bop your way to the end, avoiding monsters and collecting gems along the way. Designed and developed by Noodlebake. Sound design by Noodlebake. Music by Big Empty Zero + Scatterboxx. Character design by Big Empty Zero & Noodlebake. A selection of assets were created using text-prompted AI (Dall-e2, Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, and Starry AI).

Stream/download the song for free or by donation - bigemptyzero.bandcamp.com.
